tentang.teks: An extreme weather risk map for every kelurahan in Surabaya, built from model forecasts and grouped by BMKG categories.
tentang.cakupanTeks: Each kelurahan has its own risk category for rainfall, temperature, wind speed, and visibility.
tentang.sumberTeks: Hourly weather data comes from NASA POWER and Open-Meteo at a point for each kelurahan, validated against observations from BMKG stations in Surabaya.
tentang.batasTeks: Forecasts are updated daily at 12:00 WIB for the next day, 00:00–23:59 WIB. They are model predictions, not official BMKG warnings; for safety decisions, follow official BMKG information.

kumpul.teks: Hourly weather data is collected from several sources for every kelurahan.

prediksi.teks: A model forecasts conditions for the next 24 hours.

petakan.teks: Results are mapped per kelurahan using BMKG categories.

kirim.teks: At 12:00 WIB, alerts are sent to registered users on WhatsApp.

parameter.teks: Each parameter is rated against BMKG category thresholds and can be chosen to color the map.
parameter.catatanHujan: For summaries and WhatsApp alerts, a rainfall extreme event starts at the Heavy Rain category. Other parameters count when their extreme category is met.

wa.teks: Choose up to 3 kelurahan. A risk summary is sent at 12:00 WIB for the next day, 00:00–23:59 WIB.

langkah.pilih: Sign up and choose up to 3 kelurahan to watch.
langkah.verifikasi: Verify your WhatsApp number with an OTP code.
langkah.terima: Receive tomorrow's risk summary every day at 12:00 WIB.

wa.catatanBahasa: WhatsApp alerts are currently sent in Indonesian.

resmi.tanya: Is this an official BMKG warning?
resmi.jawab: No. The information here comes from model predictions that use BMKG category thresholds as a reference. For official warnings, follow BMKG's official channels.

akurasi.jawab: The model is evaluated against observations from BMKG stations in Surabaya. Like any weather forecast, it can be wrong, especially for short, local rain. Use it as one input, not the only basis for decisions.

gratis.jawab: Yes, it is free for users.

berhenti.tanya: How do I stop receiving messages?
berhenti.jawab: Log in, open Settings, and turn off WhatsApp Early Warnings. You can also delete your account at any time from the same page.

data.tanya: What is my personal data used for?
data.jawab: Your name, email, and WhatsApp number are used only for your account and for sending early warnings. Account data is permanently deleted when you delete your account.
